items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, now day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; monitored throughout week
items.implication: Status up in air for Week 2; handcuff/backup WRs elevated if out

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers suffered hamstring injury (left early Week 1) not considered serious. Would have returned if playoff game. Day-to-day heading into MRI/testing; coach confirms DTD good sign.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated but mild per sources
items.implication: Likely available or limited Week 2; Bateman/others gain if sits

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per reports/coach. Same left knee had PCL sprain + bone bruise last season—scary.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery progressing; coach optimistic but history concerning
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer holds TE value short-term if delayed

items.text: Kenneth Walker was a true workhorse in KC debut: handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. As expected he fucks.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, high route/target share in new offense
items.implication: Clear RB1/workhorse value ROS in KC
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly on RB touches/routes early; receiving involvement strong

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: tied Bijan for No.1 Utilization Score (99), 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes into 21% targets, 23 att +6 tgts, 156 yds +2 rec TDs. Every-down player.
items.why: Dominant utilization + efficiency behind improved OL; historical comps elite PPG
items.implication: Treat as locked high-end RB1 ROS

items.text: Bucky Irving upgrades to mid-range RB2: 62% snaps, 58% routes (incl LDD), 53% rushes, short-yardage lead, 85 Util Score. Outperformed Gainwell; historical 85 Util ~16.4 PPG top-12 heavy.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in key situations despite early draft concerns
items.implication: Start as mid-RB2; Gainwell mid-RB4 hold

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2.
items.why: Extreme core four dominance in efficient offense
items.implication: Start the four with high confidence; ignore depth

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). But sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Great matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: Healthy, goal-line/work over Gainwell, solid routes despite modest carries
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; hold/start confidently
items.opportunity: GL work, route edge, health confirmed post prior injuries

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4. Committee persists.
items.why: Even with Kamara inactive, three-way split limited Etienne monopoly
items.implication: Low-end RB2 until clearer lead; Kamara return further dilutes
items.opportunity: Still led but not workhorse; two-minute share notable

items.text: Malik Nabers first game since ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Strong route/target share immediately post major injury
items.implication: WR1 upside intact; ramp fully expected
items.opportunity: High target share and routes on limited snaps

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and confirmed ACTIVE Week 1. Berry: risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere; wouldn't activate if worried. Low-end RB short-term, borderline RB1 upside ROS per util.
items.why: Cleared and played; split with Allgeier but upside high
items.implication: Start with risk; role expansion likely
items.opportunity: Routes/TPRR edge already; lead role incoming

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT tiny at 4.9; last night 2.5. Needs serious volume for box-score payoff. Only 2 targets (7% share) notable, but routes strong: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30).
items.why: Routes present but shallow targets/aDOT limit ceiling without volume spike
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; patience warranted after low-target debut
items.opportunity: High route share alongside Worthy; red-zone screen upside shown

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: even w/ Kamara out only 58% snaps/43% att/38% routes in three-way committee. Efficiency good but volume capped; Kamara return looming.
items.why: Committee usage despite absence of Kamara; not the workhorse hoped
items.implication: Temper expectations; flex/low RB2 until role clarifies
items.opportunity: Two-minute share positive but overall diluted

items.text: David Montgomery upgrades high-end RB2: clear RB1 on ground 65% attempts (all inside-5), short-yardage lead despite 50/50 camp talk. 79 Util historically solid PPG; Marks two-minute only.
items.why: Goal-line/short-yardage monopoly + rush share in shootout
items.implication: High-end RB2 starter; Marks contingent RB4
